title: Workout upload request body (garmin.upload_workout)
description:
Shape of the body sync_pending_workouts (sync/sync.py, _build_garmin_workout/_build_garmin_step/_build_garmin_repeat_group) sends to garminconnect's upload_workout. Unlike the other schemas in this directory, this isn't derived from a currently-committed fixture — it documents the confirmed-correct structure that a real captured hand-built workout (sync/tests/fixtures/workout_1646566436.json) verified during development, before that fixture was removed for containing real account PII (ownerId, author.userProfilePk). The structural facts below (stepOrder as a single running counter, childStepId grouping, explicit-null serialization, rest-step targetType) are still true and load-bearing for _build_garmin_workout/_build_garmin_repeat_group — see CLAUDE.md's 'RepeatGroupDTO structure' section.

This is a request-body schema, not a response schema — it covers only the fields sync.py constructs and sends, not the additional server-assigned fields (author, timestamps, ownerId, etc.) a GET on the resulting workout would return.

workoutId.description: Always null on upload — Garmin assigns this and returns it in the response.

ownerId.description: Always null on upload — Garmin assigns this from the authenticated session.

description.description: Always null — not currently settable via create_workout.

workoutSegments.description: sync.py always emits exactly one segment.

sportType.description: One of the verified {sportTypeId, sportTypeKey} pairs in CLAUDE.md's 'Garmin workout-service sport/step type IDs' table (running=1, cycling=2, swimming=4, strength_training=5). Both id and key must match Garmin's own mapping — a mismatched pair is silently resolved by id, mislabeling the workout (see the strength_training=13/swimming=5 bug this table exists to prevent).

stepType.description: One of the verified {stepTypeId, stepTypeKey} pairs in CLAUDE.md (warmup=1, cooldown=2, interval=3, recovery=4, rest=5, repeat=6, other=7). rest/repeat are internal-only — synthesized by _build_garmin_repeat_group, never read from a user-supplied step type.

endCondition.description: Selected by which of duration_s/distance_m/reps is present on the source step, in that priority order. Falls back to lap.button (manual) if none are set.

oneOf.description: Real Garmin rest steps serialize targetType as null — confirmed against a captured real hand-built strength workout. _build_garmin_step emits null here whenever the source step's type is "rest" and no explicit HR zone target is set.
heart.rate.zone when a target_hr_zone is set on the source step; no.target (still an explicit object, not null/omitted) for every other non-rest step.

stepOrder.description: A single running counter across the ENTIRE step tree, confirmed against a captured real workout — not reset per repeat group, and the repeat group node itself consumes one value before its children. No gaps between siblings.

childStepId.description: Integer group-membership marker, shared by a RepeatGroupDTO node and its children (sequential per group in order of appearance); null for steps outside any repeat group.

endConditionValue.description: float matching the chosen end condition's unit (seconds/meters/rep count), or null for lap.button.

targetValueOne.description: HR zone number (both targetValueOne and targetValueTwo set to the same value) when targetType is heart.rate.zone; null otherwise.

category.description: Exercise catalog category (e.g. "BENCH_PRESS") for strength steps — see internal/garmin/exercises/catalog.json. Real Garmin workouts serialize this as an explicit null when unset, not an omitted key — confirmed against a captured real workout; _build_garmin_step always emits the key.

exerciseName.description: Exercise catalog exercise_name (e.g. "BARBELL_BENCH_PRESS") paired with category. Same explicit-null convention as category.

description.description: Same explicit-null convention as category/exerciseName. Not currently settable via create_workout (always null).

repeatGroup.title: RepeatGroupDTO
repeatGroup.description: Wraps one [exercise, rest] pair, repeated `sets` times. Scope limit in _build_garmin_repeat_group: only ever one exercise+rest pair per group — Garmin's real format also supports multi-exercise supersets (a captured real workout had groups with two alternating exercises before a rest), but WorkoutStep/create_workout don't model that.

stepOrder.description: The group node itself consumes one stepOrder value before its children — see executableStep.stepOrder.

childStepId.description: Shared by this group node and both its children.

numberOfIterations.description: Set count. Must equal endConditionValue — redundant-looking, but both are required by Garmin.

workoutSteps.description: Always exactly [exercise step, rest step], in that order.
